item.title: @faytuksnetwork: A CENTCOM official tells Faytuks Network that the US Air Force struck a missile launcher on Qeshm Island ealier tonight
item.description:
A CENTCOM official tells Faytuks Network that the US Air Force struck a missile launcher on Qeshm Island ealier tonight after Iran launched missiles from the area.
"This is an area we've been watching over the last week, and we were prepared to act in a defensive manner."
